name: Braun Household
legalEntityNote: Braun Household is the consumer identity for small household appliances operated under De’Longhi's perpetual licence; it is not a universal Braun legal entity. Procter & Gamble holds the Braun trademark, while De’Longhi's official filings say P&G assigned the group a perpetual licence for Braun-branded small household appliances. Braun personal care, shavers and Oral-B remain outside this household-appliance scope, and regional De’Longhi companies can hold different sales, website and warranty roles.
headline: Braun Household appliances across trademark, licence and operating boundaries
description: A source-backed profile of Braun Household, separating P&G trademark ownership, De’Longhi's household-appliance licence, regional operators, product portfolio, channels and model checks.
metaDescription: Braun Household brand profile: P&G trademark, De’Longhi licence, appliance portfolio, channels and buyer verification.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is independent and is not affiliated with Braun, P&G or De’ Longhi S.p.A. Trademark and licence evidence does not identify the legal manufacturer, factory, importer, seller or warrantor for every Braun household appliance.
headquarters: Neu-Isenburg, Germany (Braun Household brand office); Treviso, Italy (De’ Longhi S.p.A.)
founded: Braun founded in 1921; household-appliance licence transferred to De’Longhi in 2012

ownership.summary: Procter & Gamble holds the Braun trademark. De’Longhi's official 2012 reporting states that P&G assigned De’Longhi a perpetual licence for Braun-branded small household appliances. This licensed operating relationship is narrower and more precise than saying De’Longhi owns the Braun trademark; personal-care categories remain separate.

leadership.name: Max Braun
leadership.context: Braun's official brand history traces the business to engineer Max Braun in 1921; current household-appliance operations sit within the later P&G trademark and De’Longhi licence structure.

productPortfolio.name: Food preparation
productPortfolio.positioning: Braun Household's current portfolio includes hand blenders, food processors, blenders, juicers and related preparation systems.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Verify attachment compatibility, motor and voltage, food-contact declarations, replacement parts and service for the exact model.

productPortfolio.name: Breakfast and cooking
productPortfolio.positioning: Official regional catalogues include coffee makers, kettles, toasters and selected cooking appliances.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Check the destination-market assortment, plug, electrical certification, consumables, commercial-use limits and warranty provider.

productPortfolio.name: Garment care
productPortfolio.positioning: Steam irons and ironing systems form another Braun Household category under the licensed small-appliance scope.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm water requirements, voltage, soleplate or boiler specification, spare parts and local repair coverage.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: De’Longhi's 2012 filing states that P&G assigned the group a perpetual licence for the design, manufacture and distribution of Braun-branded small household appliances.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: The licensed small-household-appliance categories described in the filing; not Braun personal care or every model's factory
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Confirm that the proposed product falls inside the household licence and identify its exact legal manufacturer and factory from model documentation.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: De’Longhi Group reports a mix of own plants and manufacturing or assembly partners across its household-appliance portfolio.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Group-level production model across multiple brands, including licensed products; not a Braun model-to-factory map
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Require current model-to-factory, origin and quality-control evidence rather than assigning a group plant by assumption.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The reviewed public materials did not disclose one factory or one legal maker for every Braun Household SKU worldwide.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Match the product label, declaration, importer record and supplier documents for the contracted destination-market reference.

marketsChannels.evidence: Braun Household operates regional official sites with country-specific catalogues, retailers, support and warranty information.
marketsChannels.scope: Official household-appliance consumer channels; product ranges and operating entities vary by country
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Validate the model and seller on the destination-country site and retain evidence of authorization at purchase.

marketsChannels.evidence: The US Braun Household privacy policy identifies De’Longhi America as the operator for the reviewed site and related services.
marketsChannels.scope: Reviewed United States digital and service context; not a universal global operating-company statement
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Identify the regional De’Longhi company, distributor or seller on the local terms, invoice and warranty.

marketsChannels.evidence: De’Longhi Group lists a Braun Household brand contact office in Neu-Isenburg, Germany while maintaining regional commercial companies elsewhere.
marketsChannels.scope: Group contact architecture and brand office; not proof of the contracting entity for a purchase
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm quotation issuer, importer, returns route, parts supply and warranty entity for the destination market.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Braun Household combines a recognized design heritage with De’Longhi's small-appliance operating platform. Its trademark-licence structure makes category and entity separation a central procurement check, especially where buyers may confuse household and personal-care products.

developments.title: De’Longhi receives perpetual household-appliance licence
